title: Malted Italian Risotto with Rocket
description: A keto-friendly twist on traditional risotto, featuring malted flavors and a peppery kick from rocket.

ingredients.name: Italian-Style Risotto Rice
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use a keto-friendly brand.

ingredients.name: Malted Broth
ingredients.notes: Use a low-carb broth to stay keto.

ingredients.name: Rocket Leaves
ingredients.notes: Fresh or frozen, but make sure they're not wilted.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a keto-friendly salt, like Himalayan pink salt.

instructions: Heat the malted broth to a simmer in a separate pot.
Melt 10g of butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the Italian-Style Risotto Rice and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add 250ml of the malted broth to the skillet, stirring constantly until absorbed.
Repeat the process, adding the broth in 250ml increments, and stirring until absorbed, for 15-20 minutes, or until the risotto is cooked through.
Stir in the remaining 10g of butter and the Parmesan cheese.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the risotto to a serving dish and top with rocket leaves.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional rocket leaves if desired.
